title: Lipolysis regulates major transcriptional programs in brown adipocytes.
authors: Markussen, Lasse K; Rondini, Elizabeth A; Johansen, Olivia Sveidahl; Madsen, Jesper G S; Sustarsic, Elahu G; Marcher, Ann-Britt; Hansen, Jacob B; Gerhart-Hines, Zachary; Granneman, James G; Mandrup, Susanne
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脂肪分解对棕色脂肪细胞转录程序的调控，虽用机器学习推断转录因子，但核心是代谢信号而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: beta-Adrenergic signaling is a core regulator of brown adipocyte function stimulating both lipolysis and transcription of thermogenic genes, thereby expanding the capacity for oxidative metabolism. We have used pharmacological inhibitors and a direct activator of lipolysis to acutely modulate the activity of lipases, thereby enabling us to uncover lipolysis-dependent signaling pathways downstream of beta-adrenergic signaling in cultured brown adipocytes. Here we show that induction of lipolysis leads to acute induction of several gene programs and is required for transcriptional regulation by beta-adrenergic signals. Using machine-learning algorithms to infer causal transcription factors, we show that PPARs are key mediators of lipolysis-induced activation of genes involved in lipid metabolism and thermogenesis. Importantly, however, lipolysis also activates the unfolded protein response and regulates the core circadian transcriptional machinery independently of PPARs. Our results demonstrate that lipolysis generates important metabolic signals that exert profound pleiotropic effects on transcription and function of cultured brown adipocytes.
abstract_zh: β-肾上腺素能信号传导是棕色脂肪细胞功能的核心调节因子，刺激脂肪分解和产热基因的转录，从而扩大氧化代谢的能力。我们使用药理学抑制剂和脂肪分解的直接激活剂来急性调节脂肪酶的活性，从而能够在培养的棕色脂肪细胞中揭示β-肾上腺素能信号下游依赖脂肪分解的信号通路。在此我们显示，脂肪分解的诱导导致多个基因程序的急性激活，并且是β-肾上腺素能信号进行转录调控所必需的。利用机器学习算法推断因果转录因子，我们表明PPARs是脂肪分解诱导的脂质代谢和产热相关基因激活的关键介导因子。然而，重要的是，脂肪分解也激活未折叠蛋白反应，并独立于PPARs调节核心昼夜节律转录机制。我们的结果表明，脂肪分解产生重要的代谢信号，对培养的棕色脂肪细胞的转录和功能发挥深远的多种效应。
